actually_viewed: overview-r004.png: all four same-light-background large previews plus actual 128/48/24 renders
visible_findings: Short/full are clearly differentiated by actual neck, standing collar, connected rings, outer collar and yellow chest shoulder plate at the same canvas size.
Unmasked capsules have straight central sides and round caps; no fringe occludes their ends after r002.
Masked devices remain over both eyes and show a descending central nose plate, bent central ridge, rising near-side plate and yellow connected fixtures.
Dark inner neck now reads separately behind the pale collar in full.
Analytic face and hair fields show broad smooth color changes; no random cloud/grain shapes were authored or visibly observed in these views.
Masked r004 top metal rim follows the unchanged main silhouette after removal of the narrow double sampling band.
limitations: Hair crown and side tufts remain a substantial icon simplification, not a measured recreation of the official character.
Mask central fold and neckline preserve source relationships but are abstracted; exact source matching is not established.
Pitch has no scored pass and still requires user judgment; applying 15 degree roll is not claimed as pitch proof.
No independent new-art material masks exist for complete paint-field certification.
Tiny hair gaps and fine fixture lines lose detail at 24 px even though the major profile and mask distinction remains visible.
